feature.name: Styles
feature.what_it_does: Apply named, reusable style sets that bundle character and paragraph formatting.
feature.affects: the paragraph/character style applied to the selection
feature.behavior: Apply named, reusable style sets that bundle character and paragraph formatting. Group controls: subfeature:quick-styles, subfeature:styles-pane

subfeatures.name: Quick Styles gallery
subfeatures.what_it_does: Applies a named style (Normal, No Spacing, Heading 1/2, Title, Subtitle, Quote…) to the selection from the in-ribbon gallery.
subfeatures.behavior: Opens Quick Styles gallery (dropdown). Contents (16 controls): ¶ Normal, ¶ No Spacing, Heading 1, Heading 2, Title, Subtitle, Subtle Emphasis, Emphasis, Intense Emphasis, Strong, Quote, Intense Quote, Subtle Reference, Intense Reference, Book Title, ¶ List Paragraph. [the Quick Styles gallery — named style tiles (each applies a style)] Appears as a gallery of style previews (Normal, Heading 1, Title…).

connections.why: a style bundles the character formatting the Font dialog sets

subfeatures.name: Styles pane launcher
subfeatures.what_it_does: Opens the Styles pane — the full style list with apply/new/inspect/manage controls.
subfeatures.behavior:
Opens Styles (pane). Contents (0 controls): . [Preview, manage and customize the text styles in Word.

Use the window to see and edit formatting details for each style, create new styles, and quickly preview styles in your document.

You can also update styles to match selected text.]
